name: story-ranking-short
description: Ranking listicle short: a vertical 9:16 countdown of about 23.5 s (6 items, or 5 for a top 5; 3 to 9 items) from a text brief. An approved script with a quote, one realistic phone-footage still per item (Nano Banana Pro), one Seedance image-to-video clip per still with its own pop, filmer reaction and bass hit, then a hard-cut ffmpeg stitch with the hook title and a numbered list that fills in one line per item. Three approvals (script, first still, all stills) come before the paid steps. Use when: a ranking, top 5, ranked list or countdown short is asked for (no top 10 yet). NOT for: a narrated faceless short (story-faceless-short); a single-take short (story-one-take-short); found-footage stories (story-found-footage); a multi-shot production with voiceover and music (media-video-production); captions on a finished video (edit-captions); music or voice (media-audio-generation); a single still (media-image-generation); running ai-gen in general (media-ai-gen); file checks (media-qc).
